meta.title: 脸部上镜三要素——中篇：嘴巴
meta.title_en: Three Keys to Photogenic Faces — Part 2: The Mouth

scenes.title_cn: 微笑：当你微笑的时候，嘴角下垂或者平…
scenes.title_en: Smiling: when you smile, drooping or flat …
sentences: 当你微笑的时候，嘴角下垂或者是平行，这样都不好看。
When you smile, drooping or flat corners don't look good.
flat corners（嘴角平行）
嘴角要微微上扬，斜向苹果肌。
Lift the corners slightly, angled toward the apple cheeks.
apple cheeks（苹果肌）
发哈哈的声音，但要小声一些，嘴巴不要咧得太大。
Say ha-ha quietly—don't stretch the mouth too wide.
soft ha-ha（小声哈哈）
scenes.speak: When you smile, drooping or flat corners don't look good. Lift the corners slightly, angled toward the apple cheeks. Say ha-ha quietly—don't stretch the mouth too wide.

scenes.title_cn: 放松微张：当你不笑的时候，嘴巴不要过…
scenes.title_en: Relaxed part-open: when not smiling, don't…
scenes.context: 吐气放松嘴唇自然微张。
sentences: 嘴巴不要过度用力，要微张。
Don't tense the mouth; keep it slightly open.
slightly open（微张）
学一个小技巧叫吐气，发呼的声音。
A trick called exhaling—make a hoo sound.
exhale（吐气）
然后再进行脸部表情，这时候嘴巴就会放松了。
Then set your expression and the mouth relaxes.
mouth relaxes（嘴巴放松）
scenes.speak: Don't tense the mouth; keep it slightly open. A trick called exhaling—make a hoo sound. Then set your expression and the mouth relaxes.

scenes.title_cn: 嘟嘴：当你嘟嘴的时候，嘴巴不要过度用…
scenes.title_en: Pouting: when you pout, don't tense too ha…
scenes.context: 吹口哨想象让嘟嘴自然。
sentences: 当你嘟嘴的时候，嘴巴不要过度用力。
When you pout, don't tense too hard.
don't over-tense（别过度用力）
想象我们在吹口哨，或者嘴里含了一颗口哨糖。
Imagine whistling, or a whistle candy in your mouth.
whistle candy（口哨糖）
这样的嘴巴管理，你们控制住了吗？
That's the mouth control—got it?
mouth control（嘴巴管理）
scenes.speak: When you pout, don't tense too hard. Imagine whistling, or a whistle candy in your mouth. That's the mouth control—got it?

practice: Lift the corners toward the apple cheeks.
Say ha-ha quietly, not a big open mouth.
Exhale with a hoo sound, then set the face.
Imagine whistling or a whistle candy.
pitfalls: Smile with flat or drooping corners.
Lift the corners toward the apple cheeks.
嘴角平行或下垂都不好看。
Say ha-ha with a huge mouth.
小声发哈哈，嘴巴别咧太大。
Tense the mouth when relaxing it.
Exhale with a hoo sound to soften it.
吐气能让嘴唇自然放松。
Imagine whistling or a whistle candy.
shifts: 用 corner lift（嘴角上扬）、apple cheeks（苹果肌）
用 exhale（吐气）、hoo sound（呼的声音）、part-open（微张）
用 whistle candy（口哨糖）、pout（嘟嘴）、lip seam（唇缝）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：嘴角下垂平行、嘴角上扬、斜向苹果肌、发哈哈声音、小声、嘴巴咧太大、不笑时微张、吐气、发呼、脸部表情、嘴巴放松、嘟嘴、吹口哨、口哨糖、嘴巴管理等。
